scientific_contract.test_definition: This report comes from your self-descriptions across 60 items. It organizes emotional awareness, regulation, empathic understanding, and relational-action tendencies in this response session; it is not external observation or an objective ability test.
scientific_contract.self_report_statement: EQ-60 is a self-report tool. The result can support reflection, tracking, and review, but it cannot directly prove how you perform in real situations.
scientific_contract.non_clinical_statement: This report is not for clinical diagnosis, treatment evaluation, medical advice, crisis decisions, or psychological risk assessment. If distress keeps affecting sleep, work, interpersonal safety, or daily functioning, seek qualified professional or real-world support.
scientific_contract.non_hiring_statement: This result must not be used for hiring, selection, rejection, promotion, role assignment, performance review, team screening, or any high-stakes organizational decision. It should not be used to judge whether another person is suitable for a role.
scientific_contract.non_ability_statement: EQ-60 is not an emotional-ability test, MSCEIT, certification, clinical tool, or hiring tool. It cannot prove communication, relationship, or work ability.
scientific_contract.norm_status_statement: Read standard scores, percentiles, and bands with the reference version stated in the report. With a bootstrap or other model-based reference, percentiles are estimated from model parameters, not observed sample ranks. With sample-based norms, use the stated reference group and version. They do not rank ability, worth, or career competitiveness.
scientific_contract.quality_rules_statement: Interpretation confidence considers response speed, repeated identical choices, extreme choices, neutral choices, and consistency signals. Low-confidence results should be treated primarily as response-quality guidance and retest advice, not as strong profiling, career conclusions, or practice recommendations.
scientific_contract.version_statement: The report records item, scoring, norm, and content versions for retest comparison and quality tracking; version numbers do not confer clinical, hiring, or ability certification.
scientific_contract.user_safe_summary: Use it for self-understanding, relational reflection, low-risk communication practice, and work-environment variable review.
scientific_contract.do_not_overread: Read the report as an interpretive sketch of this self-report session, not for clinical diagnosis, hiring, career prediction, job-performance prediction, or evaluation of another person.

global_index.label: Emotional & Relational Functioning Index
global_index.definition: The index combines four self-report dimensions into a reading entry for the emotional and relational self-perception pattern shown in this response session.
global_index.not_a_capability_score: It is not an emotional-ability score, live-performance score, career-competitiveness score, or final global norm ranking; use it as navigation into dimensions and scene explanations.
global_index.how_to_use: Use the overview first, then return to dimensions, response quality, evidence status, and real-life scenes. Do not use the total score by itself to judge yourself or others.

score_notes.percentile: A percentile depends on the reference version stated in the report: a bootstrap or other model-based reference gives a position estimated from model parameters, not an observed sample rank; sample-based norms should be read with the stated reference group and version. It is not an ability ranking, true-level ranking, final global norm, or career-competitiveness ranking.
score_notes.standard_score: Standard score supports stable display and dimension comparison. It is a reading entry, not proof of live performance or ability.
score_notes.band: Bands reduce reading effort; they are not fixed identities, credentials, clinical findings, hiring signals, or career judgments.
score_notes.provisional_norm: Current norms are provisional. Future samples, language versions, and content versions may change interpretation boundaries.
score_notes.commercial_boundary: The total score should not be used alone; full interpretation requires dimensions, quality, evidence status, mechanisms, and scene boundaries.

foundational.label: Foundational
foundational.meaning: The current self-report signal suggests starting with clearer recognition, naming, and reset habits.
foundational.strength: Small repeatable actions can create more stable progress.
foundational.risk: Jumping into complex communication tactics may frustrate you if the base signal is unclear.
foundational.practice_focus: Name one emotion daily and pair it with one low-cost reset action.
foundational.do_not_overread: Use this band as a practice starting point, not an ability floor.

developing.label: Developing
developing.meaning: You have a usable base, but consistency may drop during feedback, pressure, or relational tension.
developing.strength: You already catch part of the signal and can turn it into a routine.
developing.risk: The common trap is knowing something but not using it in the moment.
developing.practice_focus: Pick one frequent scene and prepare one response sentence.
developing.do_not_overread: It describes this session’s self-rating, not how you always act.

stable.label: Stable
stable.meaning: In many everyday settings, these emotional and relational patterns are easier to use, with specific triggers still visible.
stable.strength: Your result can support more precise scene-based practice.
stable.risk: Stability does not mean no cost, especially in high-intensity relational environments.
stable.practice_focus: Identify one scene where stability drops and review it afterward.
stable.do_not_overread: “Stable” can change with pressure and context; it is not trait proof.

proficient.label: Proficient
proficient.meaning: You can usually recognize, regulate, and handle relational signals with good consistency.
proficient.strength: You can turn personal strengths into repeatable communication habits.
proficient.risk: Others may assume you should always be the stabilizing person.
proficient.practice_focus: Move from “I can handle this” to “I choose how to handle this.”
proficient.do_not_overread: “Proficient” is not an ability credential or a duty to stabilize others.

integrated.label: Integrated
integrated.meaning: The four signals often work together, helping you hold self, others, and the relationship goal in view.
integrated.strength: You can systematize strengths into boundaries, repair, and recovery rhythm.
integrated.risk: High integration may still create over-responsibility and high-standard fatigue.
integrated.practice_focus: Build recovery boundaries so stabilizing others does not become your default duty.
integrated.do_not_overread: “Integrated” does not mean no blind spots and is not for career decisions.

SA.label: Self-Awareness
SA.definition: A self-reported tendency to notice emotions, triggers, body signals, and current needs; it is not externally observed self-knowledge ability and does not guarantee clear expression in the moment.
SA.what_high_can_look_like: You can often identify feelings and triggers quickly, while still needing to turn awareness into action.
SA.what_low_can_look_like: Feelings may become clear only afterward, making it easier to react before understanding.
SA.development_question: What am I actually feeling and needing right now?
SA.do_not_overread: The Self-Awareness score describes a relative tendency in this self-report session; it is not proof of ability, a fixed label, a diagnosis, or a prediction of external behavior.

ER.label: Emotion Regulation
ER.definition: A self-reported tendency to pause, reset, and choose responses after pressure, feedback, frustration, or conflict; it is not the same as always staying calm, suppressing emotion, or proving resilience.
ER.what_high_can_look_like: You can often pause, recover, and choose a response under pressure, without being emotionless.
ER.what_low_can_look_like: Recovery may take longer after being triggered, with avoidance, over-explaining, or suppression becoming common.
ER.development_question: Can I lower the heat first before choosing my response?
ER.do_not_overread: The Emotion Regulation score describes a relative tendency in this self-report session; it is not proof of ability, a fixed label, a diagnosis, or a prediction of external behavior.

EM.label: Empathy
EM.definition: A self-reported tendency to understand others’ emotional cues, perspectives, and possible feelings; it may reflect cognitive and affective empathy signals, but it is not mind-reading accuracy, prosocial behavior, or taking on others’ distress.
EM.what_high_can_look_like: You can notice others’ emotional states, while still needing boundaries against over-absorbing.
EM.what_low_can_look_like: You may focus on tasks or facts and miss some emotional cues.
EM.development_question: What is the other person really concerned about?
EM.do_not_overread: The Empathy score describes a relative tendency in this self-report session; it is not proof of ability, a fixed label, a diagnosis, or a prediction of external behavior.

RM.label: Relationship Management
RM.definition: A self-reported tendency around expression, collaboration, boundaries, and relationship repair; it does not directly predict relationship quality, leadership, popularity, or others’ evaluations.
RM.what_high_can_look_like: You can maintain communication and relationship quality, while still watching for honest expression and boundaries.
RM.what_low_can_look_like: Even when feelings are clear, repairing or moving the conversation forward may be harder.
RM.development_question: How can I say this honestly while keeping the conversation open?
RM.do_not_overread: The Relationship Management score describes a relative tendency in this self-report session; it is not proof of ability, a fixed label, a diagnosis, or a prediction of external behavior.

core_formulation.title: Self-reported pattern: High sensitivity, stronger absorption
core_formulation.one_liner: In this self-report, you appear sensitive to emotional cues in yourself and others, and you may also experience the emotional atmosphere as entering your own system more strongly.
core_formulation.core_claim: This is not a high-sensitivity diagnosis or an ability label. It suggests emotional information may have stronger subjective impact, making it useful to separate information, feeling, and responsibility.
evidence_basis: The four relative dimension positions and response quality support this interpretation; check it against real situations.
core_formulation.primary_strength: You may notice subtle signals and changes in relationship tone earlier than you expect.
core_formulation.likely_cost: Without filtering, another person’s tension, disappointment, or expectation can start to feel like your task.
core_formulation.development_lever: Practice three-way sorting: what I observed, how it affected me, and what action is actually mine.
core_formulation.do_not_overread: Check this interpretation against real feedback and specific situations; it does not replace behavioral observation.
core_formulation.share_line: This self-report suggests higher sensitivity and a need to filter which emotional information should become action.

mechanisms.title: Empathy understanding x emotion regulation: strong cue, weaker follow-through
mechanisms.why_it_matters: This mechanism focuses on how understanding others connects to not absorbing the whole emotional load. It helps locate which link in the chain needs observation, but it cannot by itself predict real-world behavior.
mechanisms.what_it_feels_like: The first signal is clearer, but the second step may be less steady, creating a “noticed it but could not carry it forward” pattern.
mechanisms.strength: The strength is a clear entry point: you know where the chain begins.
mechanisms.cost: The cost is that clearer signals can create more pressure or self-criticism when follow-through is weaker.
mechanisms.development_lever: Next practice focus: After empathy, separate what you understand, what you will take on, and what you need to recover from. Use it as a concrete review entry point, not proof of a fixed deficit.
mechanisms.micro_action: Micro-action: in the next similar scene, add only one step. After empathy, separate what you understand, what you will take on, and what you need to recover from.
mechanisms.do_not_overread: Check recovering your attention after empathy in a real situation; the EM_ER score combination does not establish cause or ability.

mechanisms.title: Self-awareness x emotion regulation: strong cue, weaker follow-through
mechanisms.why_it_matters: This mechanism focuses on how noticing your inner state connects to recovery and response. It helps locate which link in the chain needs observation, but it cannot by itself predict real-world behavior.
mechanisms.what_it_feels_like: The first signal is clearer, but the second step may be less steady, creating a “noticed it but could not carry it forward” pattern.
mechanisms.strength: The strength is a clear entry point: you know where the chain begins.
mechanisms.cost: The cost is that clearer signals can create more pressure or self-criticism when follow-through is weaker.
mechanisms.development_lever: Next practice focus: After naming the emotion, add one slowing or recovery step. Use it as a concrete review entry point, not proof of a fixed deficit.
mechanisms.micro_action: Micro-action: in the next similar scene, add only one step. After naming the emotion, add one slowing or recovery step.
mechanisms.do_not_overread: Check noticing your inner state and making room to recover in a real situation; the SA_ER score combination does not establish cause or ability.

reality_scenes.title: Team collaboration: translate atmosphere into roles
reality_scenes.typical_response: This response suggests the self-perceived pattern “High sensitivity, stronger absorption.” In teamwork, check whether you quietly take on emotional coordination or gap-filling beyond the task itself.
reality_scenes.strength: The useful possibility is noticing task and relationship demands together, then making hidden work explicit.
reality_scenes.cost: When roles are unclear, the person most willing to coordinate can inherit unnamed responsibility.
reality_scenes.better_move: Do one thing: rewrite the current difficulty as roles, one owner, and a deadline.
reality_scenes.micro_script: Who owns this, when is it due, and who decides if it gets blocked?
reality_scenes.reflection_question: Are you completing your role, or carrying coordination work the team has not named?
reality_scenes.reflection_prompt: Record the owner, deadline, and who decides when work is blocked.
reality_scenes.do_not_overread: This is a teamwork observation, not a judgment of anyone's ability.
reality_scenes.why_this_matters: Converts team atmosphere into roles and process that can be checked.
reality_scenes.tiny_experiment: Before the next collaboration, record the owner, decision maker, and deadline.
reality_scenes.result_page_depth: For teamwork review, not for judging team or individual performance.
reality_scenes.context: When several people work with unclear goals, overlapping responsibility, or uneven pace.

reality_scenes.title: Pressure recovery: recover before committing
reality_scenes.typical_response: This response suggests the self-perceived pattern “High sensitivity, stronger absorption.” As pressure accumulates, check whether you notice reduced attention instead of treating endurance as steadiness.
reality_scenes.strength: The useful possibility is treating fatigue as a state that needs care, not as a character flaw.
reality_scenes.cost: Without recovery, regulation can become suppression and later appear as numbness, escalation, or avoidance.
reality_scenes.better_move: Do one thing: schedule a defined short pause before explaining, committing, or deciding.
reality_scenes.micro_script: I need ten minutes to recover my attention, then I can give you a clear response.
reality_scenes.reflection_question: Can you still understand the information and decide, or are you only sustaining a reaction?
reality_scenes.reflection_prompt: Record the pressure cue, pause length, and response after recovery.
reality_scenes.do_not_overread: Persistent sleep loss, severe distress, or impaired functioning needs real-world support, not only a micro-practice.
reality_scenes.why_this_matters: Turns endurance into one explicit, schedulable recovery step.
reality_scenes.tiny_experiment: At the next pressure spike, take one short pause and then note whether the decision became clearer.
reality_scenes.result_page_depth: For recovery-rhythm review, not for clinical or functioning judgments.
reality_scenes.context: After sustained demand, urgency, or emotional load, when communication or a decision is still required.

reality_scenes.title: Work-environment conditions to verify
reality_scenes.typical_response: This response suggests the self-perceived pattern “High sensitivity, stronger absorption.” It cannot decide which role fits; it only points to work conditions worth checking for communication load, boundaries, and recovery.
reality_scenes.strength: The useful possibility is turning an abstract result into questions for a real team or role.
reality_scenes.cost: Treating environment preferences as job fit can miss actual duties, culture, management, and life stage.
reality_scenes.better_move: Do one thing: verify whether people can pause, ask for help, or hand off work as pressure rises.
reality_scenes.micro_script: When pressure rises here, can people pause, ask for help, or hand work off?
reality_scenes.reflection_question: Is feedback specific, can conflict pause, are boundaries respected, and can recovery be planned?
reality_scenes.reflection_prompt: Record one real environment, observable evidence, and one open question.
reality_scenes.do_not_overread: These are conditions to verify, not evidence of job fit, selection, or performance.
reality_scenes.why_this_matters: Replaces a career judgment with a check of actual work conditions.
reality_scenes.tiny_experiment: Choose one real team and answer this environment question from public rules or direct experience.
reality_scenes.result_page_depth: For checking work conditions, not for job-fit or performance prediction.
reality_scenes.context: When checking team norms, management style, feedback rhythm, interpersonal density, and recovery space.

career_environment.label: Emotional labor: high
career_environment.meaning: how often the work asks people to absorb, soothe, coordinate, or manage others’ emotions
career_environment.fit_signal: Observe whether soothing, coordinating, and carrying emotion are formally recognized.
career_environment.strain_signal: Possible strain condition: if rules, power differences, support, and recovery space are unclear, high emotional labor can still create pressure.
career_environment.interview_question: Does high emotional labor come with supervision, review, boundaries, and recovery practices?
role_observation_checklist: Whether emotional labor is formally recognized
Whether there is review and rotation
Whether soothing others is treated as a personal obligation
career_environment.team_risk: When emotional labor is invisible, willing listeners can end up carrying it repeatedly.
career_environment.recovery_condition: Check for supervision, rotation, boundaries, and recovery around emotional labor.
career_environment.what_to_verify: Does high emotional labor come with supervision, review, boundaries, and recovery practices? Also observe the actual role, organization culture, management style, power structure, team resources, and your current life context.
career_environment.do_not_overread: Emotional-labor level does not establish career fit or performance.

career_environment.label: Autonomy and recovery space: high

career_environment.fit_signal: Observe whether pausing and handoff remain available when workload or emotion rises.
career_environment.strain_signal: Possible strain condition: if rules, power differences, support, and recovery space are unclear, high autonomy and recovery space can still create pressure.
career_environment.interview_question: Does high autonomy come with clear goals and feedback, rather than leaving people isolated?
role_observation_checklist: Whether short pauses are possible
Whether handoff and backup exist
Whether autonomy turns into lack of support
career_environment.team_risk: When responsibility lacks backup, apparent autonomy can become unsupported pressure.
career_environment.recovery_condition: Check whether recovery time is predictable rather than dependent on the day’s mood.
career_environment.what_to_verify: Does high autonomy come with clear goals and feedback, rather than leaving people isolated? Also observe the actual role, organization culture, management style, power structure, team resources, and your current life context.
career_environment.do_not_overread: Recovery access is a condition to verify, not a selection or performance signal.

action_prescription.title: Relationship Energy Management
action_prescription.why_this_matters: After high-contact or emotionally loaded situations, give yourself a concrete recovery routine.
action_prescription.do_today: Today, use one low-risk version of this sentence: “I need ten minutes to reset before we continue this conversation.”
action_prescription.script: I need ten minutes to reset before we continue this conversation.

seven_day_plan.practice: Observe one real situation connected to Relationship Energy Management.
Write down the trigger that shows up most often.
Try the first sentence of the script once.
Split one conversation into facts, feelings, and next action.
Make one small boundary or repair move.
Review one imperfect but improved attempt.
Choose one sentence to keep practicing next week.

action_prescription.common_failure: The common failure is not lack of knowledge. It is remembering the tool only after the emotion is already high.
action_prescription.repair_move: If you miss it, do not restart the whole plan. Review one trigger and one first sentence for next time.
action_prescription.watch_out: Do not treat this practice as a demand to change yourself or another person immediately. Use it only in low-risk, exit-safe situations without clear coercion or power pressure, and look for one clearer pause, sentence, or review.
action_prescription.do_not_overread: Treat “Relationship Energy Management” as low-risk self-observation and communication preparation, not therapy, crisis support, a guarantee of relationship repair, or advice for unsafe, coercive, abusive, trauma-triggering, or clearly power-imbalanced situations. If safety, ongoing distress, or high-conflict dynamics are involved, prioritize trusted support or professional help.

Do not treat them as precise ability rankings, diagnoses, or career judgments.

A bootstrap or other model-based reference estimates position from model parameters, rather than observed sample ranks; sample-based norms should be read with the stated reference group and version. These are not final global norms, ability rankings, or real-world performance rankings.
psychometric_evidence_status.do_not_overread: Check the reference version first: a bootstrap or other model-based reference is not an observed sample rank, and sample-based norms apply only to the stated reference group and version.

psychometric_evidence_status.next_validation_step: Continue expanding samples, stratify by language/region/age and related variables, and publish norm-version notes with interpretation limits.

psychometric_evidence_status.body: EQ-60 items, the four-dimension structure, and result-page interpretations have been mapped to self-reported emotional and relational functioning. The current evidence mainly supports content coverage and interpretation boundaries, not formal criterion validation or ability measurement.
psychometric_evidence_status.do_not_overread: Current evidence supports content coverage and interpretation boundaries only.

psychometric_evidence_status.next_validation_step: Continue review by psychometric, boundary, and localization reviewers for item coverage, dimension assignment, cultural context, and misinterpretation risk.

psychometric_evidence_status.body: Internal consistency should be estimated by language, region, and dimension after sufficient sample accumulation, with version tracking for item and report changes. The current page should not imply completed reliability evidence.

psychometric_evidence_status.what_this_means_for_user: Dimension scores can help read this response pattern, but should not be treated as fully reliability-validated stable measures.

blocks.title: Important Notice
blocks.content:
This assessment is a self‑report questionnaire for self‑reflection and skill development. It is not a medical diagnosis or psychotherapy advice.
Results depend on your current state, interpretation, and response quality.
When distress persists or daily functioning is significantly impaired, professional support is recommended.

blocks.title: Response Quality
blocks.content: Response quality is **A**: consistency and pacing are stable; interpretability is high.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.content:
Your overall EQ standard score is **105** (population mean 100, SD 15), at the **60** percentile.

This assessment covers four capabilities: Self‑Awareness (SA), Emotion Regulation (ER), Social Awareness & Empathy (EM), and Relationship Management (RM). Each section includes a standard score and a maturity band to locate strengths and training priorities.

Response quality: **A**.

blocks.title: Self‑Awareness · Competent
blocks.content:
**Dimension: Self‑Awareness**

Standard score: **** ( percentile), band: **Competent**.

You usually identify emotions and connect them to triggers and needs. In many situations you can say things like “I’m tense,” “I need a moment,” or “I felt overlooked.” This reduces misunderstanding and rumination, keeping conversations closer to the real issue.

**Practice**: Before a key conversation, write one sentence: “What matters most to me here?”

blocks.title: Emotion Regulation · Competent
blocks.content:
**Dimension: Emotion Regulation**

Standard score: **** ( percentile), band: **Competent**.

Most of the time you keep emotional intensity within a workable range. You can pause, reflect, and act. Even when you get pulled off track, you know how to return—breath, environment change, and a concrete next step.

**Practice**: Turn rumination into action: write 1 task you can finish in 10 minutes.

blocks.title: Social Awareness & Empathy · Competent
blocks.content:

SA.label: Self-Awareness
SA.definition: A self-reported tendency to notice emotions, triggers, body signals, and current needs; it is not externally observed self-knowledge ability and does not guarantee clear expression in the moment.
SA.what_high_can_look_like: You can often identify feelings and triggers quickly, while still needing to turn awareness into action.
SA.what_low_can_look_like: Feelings may become clear only afterward, making it easier to react before understanding.
SA.development_question: What am I actually feeling and needing right now?
SA.do_not_overread: The Self-Awareness score describes a relative tendency in this self-report session; it is not proof of ability, a fixed label, a diagnosis, or a prediction of external behavior.

ER.label: Emotion Regulation
ER.definition: A self-reported tendency to pause, reset, and choose responses after pressure, feedback, frustration, or conflict; it is not the same as always staying calm, suppressing emotion, or proving resilience.
ER.what_high_can_look_like: You can often pause, recover, and choose a response under pressure, without being emotionless.
ER.what_low_can_look_like: Recovery may take longer after being triggered, with avoidance, over-explaining, or suppression becoming common.
ER.development_question: Can I lower the heat first before choosing my response?
ER.do_not_overread: The Emotion Regulation score describes a relative tendency in this self-report session; it is not proof of ability, a fixed label, a diagnosis, or a prediction of external behavior.

EM.label: Empathy
EM.definition: A self-reported tendency to understand others’ emotional cues, perspectives, and possible feelings; it may reflect cognitive and affective empathy signals, but it is not mind-reading accuracy, prosocial behavior, or taking on others’ distress.
EM.what_high_can_look_like: You can notice others’ emotional states, while still needing boundaries against over-absorbing.
EM.what_low_can_look_like: You may focus on tasks or facts and miss some emotional cues.
EM.development_question: What is the other person really concerned about?
EM.do_not_overread: The Empathy score describes a relative tendency in this self-report session; it is not proof of ability, a fixed label, a diagnosis, or a prediction of external behavior.

RM.label: Relationship Management
RM.definition: A self-reported tendency around expression, collaboration, boundaries, and relationship repair; it does not directly predict relationship quality, leadership, popularity, or others’ evaluations.
RM.what_high_can_look_like: You can maintain communication and relationship quality, while still watching for honest expression and boundaries.
RM.what_low_can_look_like: Even when feelings are clear, repairing or moving the conversation forward may be harder.
RM.development_question: How can I say this honestly while keeping the conversation open?
RM.do_not_overread: The Relationship Management score describes a relative tendency in this self-report session; it is not proof of ability, a fixed label, a diagnosis, or a prediction of external behavior.

core_formulation.title: Self-reported pattern: High sensitivity, stronger absorption
core_formulation.one_liner: In this self-report, you appear sensitive to emotional cues in yourself and others, and you may also experience the emotional atmosphere as entering your own system more strongly.
core_formulation.core_claim: This is not a high-sensitivity diagnosis or an ability label. It suggests emotional information may have stronger subjective impact, making it useful to separate information, feeling, and responsibility.
evidence_basis: The four relative dimension positions and response quality support this interpretation; check it against real situations.
core_formulation.primary_strength: You may notice subtle signals and changes in relationship tone earlier than you expect.
core_formulation.likely_cost: Without filtering, another person’s tension, disappointment, or expectation can start to feel like your task.
core_formulation.development_lever: Practice three-way sorting: what I observed, how it affected me, and what action is actually mine.
core_formulation.do_not_overread: Check this interpretation against real feedback and specific situations; it does not replace behavioral observation.
core_formulation.share_line: This self-report suggests higher sensitivity and a need to filter which emotional information should become action.

mechanisms.title: Empathy understanding x emotion regulation: strong cue, weaker follow-through
mechanisms.why_it_matters: This mechanism focuses on how understanding others connects to not absorbing the whole emotional load. It helps locate which link in the chain needs observation, but it cannot by itself predict real-world behavior.
mechanisms.what_it_feels_like: The first signal is clearer, but the second step may be less steady, creating a “noticed it but could not carry it forward” pattern.
mechanisms.strength: The strength is a clear entry point: you know where the chain begins.
mechanisms.cost: The cost is that clearer signals can create more pressure or self-criticism when follow-through is weaker.
mechanisms.development_lever: Next practice focus: After empathy, separate what you understand, what you will take on, and what you need to recover from. Use it as a concrete review entry point, not proof of a fixed deficit.
mechanisms.micro_action: Micro-action: in the next similar scene, add only one step. After empathy, separate what you understand, what you will take on, and what you need to recover from.
mechanisms.do_not_overread: Check recovering your attention after empathy in a real situation; the EM_ER score combination does not establish cause or ability.

mechanisms.title: Self-awareness x emotion regulation: strong cue, weaker follow-through
mechanisms.why_it_matters: This mechanism focuses on how noticing your inner state connects to recovery and response. It helps locate which link in the chain needs observation, but it cannot by itself predict real-world behavior.
mechanisms.what_it_feels_like: The first signal is clearer, but the second step may be less steady, creating a “noticed it but could not carry it forward” pattern.
mechanisms.strength: The strength is a clear entry point: you know where the chain begins.
mechanisms.cost: The cost is that clearer signals can create more pressure or self-criticism when follow-through is weaker.

mechanisms.micro_action: Micro-action: in the next similar scene, add only one step. After naming the emotion, add one slowing or recovery step.
mechanisms.do_not_overread: Check noticing your inner state and making room to recover in a real situation; the SA_ER score combination does not establish cause or ability.

reality_scenes.title: Team collaboration: translate atmosphere into roles
reality_scenes.typical_response: This response suggests the self-perceived pattern “High sensitivity, stronger absorption.” In teamwork, check whether you quietly take on emotional coordination or gap-filling beyond the task itself.
reality_scenes.strength: The useful possibility is noticing task and relationship demands together, then making hidden work explicit.
reality_scenes.cost: When roles are unclear, the person most willing to coordinate can inherit unnamed responsibility.
reality_scenes.better_move: Do one thing: rewrite the current difficulty as roles, one owner, and a deadline.
reality_scenes.micro_script: Who owns this, when is it due, and who decides if it gets blocked?
reality_scenes.reflection_question: Are you completing your role, or carrying coordination work the team has not named?
reality_scenes.reflection_prompt: Record the owner, deadline, and who decides when work is blocked.
reality_scenes.do_not_overread: This is a teamwork observation, not a judgment of anyone's ability.
reality_scenes.why_this_matters: Converts team atmosphere into roles and process that can be checked.
reality_scenes.tiny_experiment: Before the next collaboration, record the owner, decision maker, and deadline.
reality_scenes.result_page_depth: For teamwork review, not for judging team or individual performance.
reality_scenes.context: When several people work with unclear goals, overlapping responsibility, or uneven pace.

reality_scenes.title: Pressure recovery: recover before committing
reality_scenes.typical_response: This response suggests the self-perceived pattern “High sensitivity, stronger absorption.” As pressure accumulates, check whether you notice reduced attention instead of treating endurance as steadiness.
reality_scenes.strength: The useful possibility is treating fatigue as a state that needs care, not as a character flaw.
reality_scenes.cost: Without recovery, regulation can become suppression and later appear as numbness, escalation, or avoidance.
reality_scenes.better_move: Do one thing: schedule a defined short pause before explaining, committing, or deciding.
reality_scenes.micro_script: I need ten minutes to recover my attention, then I can give you a clear response.
reality_scenes.reflection_question: Can you still understand the information and decide, or are you only sustaining a reaction?
reality_scenes.reflection_prompt: Record the pressure cue, pause length, and response after recovery.
reality_scenes.do_not_overread: Persistent sleep loss, severe distress, or impaired functioning needs real-world support, not only a micro-practice.
reality_scenes.why_this_matters: Turns endurance into one explicit, schedulable recovery step.
reality_scenes.tiny_experiment: At the next pressure spike, take one short pause and then note whether the decision became clearer.
reality_scenes.result_page_depth: For recovery-rhythm review, not for clinical or functioning judgments.

action_prescription.title: Relationship Energy Management
action_prescription.why_this_matters: After high-contact or emotionally loaded situations, give yourself a concrete recovery routine.
action_prescription.do_today: Today, use one low-risk version of this sentence: “I need ten minutes to reset before we continue this conversation.”
action_prescription.script: I need ten minutes to reset before we continue this conversation.

seven_day_plan.practice: Observe one real situation connected to Relationship Energy Management.
Write down the trigger that shows up most often.
Try the first sentence of the script once.
Split one conversation into facts, feelings, and next action.
Make one small boundary or repair move.
Review one imperfect but improved attempt.
Choose one sentence to keep practicing next week.

action_prescription.common_failure: The common failure is not lack of knowledge. It is remembering the tool only after the emotion is already high.
action_prescription.repair_move: If you miss it, do not restart the whole plan. Review one trigger and one first sentence for next time.
action_prescription.watch_out: Do not treat this practice as a demand to change yourself or another person immediately. Use it only in low-risk, exit-safe situations without clear coercion or power pressure, and look for one clearer pause, sentence, or review.
action_prescription.do_not_overread: Treat “Relationship Energy Management” as low-risk self-observation and communication preparation, not therapy, crisis support, a guarantee of relationship repair, or advice for unsafe, coercive, abusive, trauma-triggering, or clearly power-imbalanced situations. If safety, ongoing distress, or high-conflict dynamics are involved, prioritize trusted support or professional help.

blocks.title: Important Notice
blocks.content:
This assessment is a self‑report questionnaire for self‑reflection and skill development. It is not a medical diagnosis or psychotherapy advice.
Results depend on your current state, interpretation, and response quality.
When distress persists or daily functioning is significantly impaired, professional support is recommended.

blocks.title: Response Quality
blocks.content: Response quality is **A**: consistency and pacing are stable; interpretability is high.

blocks.title: Overview
blocks.content:
Your overall EQ standard score is **105** (population mean 100, SD 15), at the **60** percentile.

This assessment covers four capabilities: Self‑Awareness (SA), Emotion Regulation (ER), Social Awareness & Empathy (EM), and Relationship Management (RM). Each section includes a standard score and a maturity band to locate strengths and training priorities.

Response quality: **A**.

blocks.title: Self‑Awareness · Competent
blocks.content:
**Dimension: Self‑Awareness**

Standard score: **** ( percentile), band: **Competent**.

You usually identify emotions and connect them to triggers and needs. In many situations you can say things like “I’m tense,” “I need a moment,” or “I felt overlooked.” This reduces misunderstanding and rumination, keeping conversations closer to the real issue.

**Practice**: Before a key conversation, write one sentence: “What matters most to me here?”

blocks.title: Emotion Regulation · Competent
blocks.content:
**Dimension: Emotion Regulation**

Standard score: **** ( percentile), band: **Competent**.

Most of the time you keep emotional intensity within a workable range. You can pause, reflect, and act. Even when you get pulled off track, you know how to return—breath, environment change, and a concrete next step.

**Practice**: Turn rumination into action: write 1 task you can finish in 10 minutes.

blocks.title: Social Awareness & Empathy · Competent
blocks.content:
**Dimension: Social Awareness & Empathy**

Standard score: **** ( percentile), band: **Competent**.

You can reliably recognize others’ emotions and the needs behind them. You often ‘hear the subtext’ and maintain respect and connection in conflict. This supports trust in teams and safety in close relationships.

**Practice**: Before advice, ask: “Do you want me to listen, or brainstorm with you?”

blocks.title: Relationship Management · Competent
blocks.content:
**Dimension: Relationship Management**

Standard score: **** ( percentile), band: **Competent**.

You communicate and collaborate well, maintain trust, and manage disagreements without breaking the relationship. You tend to balance authenticity with relationship care.

**Practice**: In conflict, align on the shared goal first, then discuss options.

blocks.title: General Profile
blocks.content:
**Your profile: General (No strong cross‑pattern detected)**

Your four dimensions do not show a strong high‑low gap pattern. This free report breaks each dimension into real‑world strengths/risks and provides a 14‑day plan to convert scores into practice.

You will get:
- A clear radar interpretation and weakest‑link focus
- Training priorities matched to your score structure
- Ready‑to‑use scripts and exercise checklists

blocks.title: General Growth Plan
blocks.content:
**14‑Day Plan: General Growth (10–15 min/day)**

Goal: improve baseline skills across the four EQ quadrants with minimal time cost.

| Day | Theme | Practice |
|---|---|---|
| Day 1 | Name emotions | 3 emotion words + trigger. |
| Day 2 | Cool‑down | Slow exhale ×6 + 1‑minute body scan. |
| Day 3 | Reflective listening | Reflect the other’s feeling once before discussing. |
| Day 4 | Fact → feeling → request | Write the 3‑sentence script. |
| Day 5 | Small action | Do one 10‑minute action; note mood change. |
| Day 6 | Boundary scripts | Write 3 “I can / I can’t” lines. |
| Day 7 | Connection | Reach out to 1 person: appreciation + specific feedback. |
| Day 8 | De‑escalate | Start conflict with 1 empathic sentence, then align goal. |
| Day 9 | Pre‑sleep unload | 5‑line open‑loop list + first step tomorrow. |
| Day10 | Perspective | Write the other’s value and worry. |
| Day11 | Feedback | Behavior + impact + expectation once. |
| Day12 | Recovery | Schedule 20 minutes restoration. |
| Day13 | Hard talk script | 5 lines: open/empathize/boundary/plan/close. |
| Day14 | Consolidate | Pick 3 best moves and add to your carry list. |

Follow the order; write one sentence daily on what you learned.

blocks.title: Methodology
blocks.content:
**Scoring (Production v1.0)**

1) 60 items use a 5‑point scale; reverse‑keyed items are flipped before aggregation (6 − response).
2) Each quadrant has 15 items. Raw sums are mapped to standard scores (mean 100, SD 15).
3) Response‑quality indicators are computed (time, long‑stringing, extreme/neutral bias, internal consistency). Only A/B quality enters the norm pool.
4) This free report includes cross‑quadrant insights and a 14‑day training plan to convert understanding into practice.

blocks.title: Closing Notes
blocks.content:
**How to use this report**: Treat this as guidance for self‑reflection and skill training. A retake interval of at least 14 days improves stability.
This platform does not use a single test result for labeling decisions.

**Dimension: Social Awareness & Empathy**

Standard score: **** ( percentile), band: **Competent**.

You can reliably recognize others’ emotions and the needs behind them. You often ‘hear the subtext’ and maintain respect and connection in conflict. This supports trust in teams and safety in close relationships.

**Practice**: Before advice, ask: “Do you want me to listen, or brainstorm with you?”

free_blocks.title: Relationship Management · Competent
free_blocks.content:
**Dimension: Relationship Management**

Standard score: **** ( percentile), band: **Competent**.

You communicate and collaborate well, maintain trust, and manage disagreements without breaking the relationship. You tend to balance authenticity with relationship care.

**Practice**: In conflict, align on the shared goal first, then discuss options.

free_blocks.title: General Profile
free_blocks.content:
**Your profile: General (No strong cross‑pattern detected)**

Your four dimensions do not show a strong high‑low gap pattern. This free report breaks each dimension into real‑world strengths/risks and provides a 14‑day plan to convert scores into practice.

You will get:
- A clear radar interpretation and weakest‑link focus
- Training priorities matched to your score structure
- Ready‑to‑use scripts and exercise checklists

free_blocks.title: General Growth Plan
free_blocks.content:
**14‑Day Plan: General Growth (10–15 min/day)**

Goal: improve baseline skills across the four EQ quadrants with minimal time cost.

| Day | Theme | Practice |
|---|---|---|
| Day 1 | Name emotions | 3 emotion words + trigger. |
| Day 2 | Cool‑down | Slow exhale ×6 + 1‑minute body scan. |
| Day 3 | Reflective listening | Reflect the other’s feeling once before discussing. |
| Day 4 | Fact → feeling → request | Write the 3‑sentence script. |
| Day 5 | Small action | Do one 10‑minute action; note mood change. |
| Day 6 | Boundary scripts | Write 3 “I can / I can’t” lines. |
| Day 7 | Connection | Reach out to 1 person: appreciation + specific feedback. |
| Day 8 | De‑escalate | Start conflict with 1 empathic sentence, then align goal. |
| Day 9 | Pre‑sleep unload | 5‑line open‑loop list + first step tomorrow. |
| Day10 | Perspective | Write the other’s value and worry. |
| Day11 | Feedback | Behavior + impact + expectation once. |
| Day12 | Recovery | Schedule 20 minutes restoration. |
| Day13 | Hard talk script | 5 lines: open/empathize/boundary/plan/close. |
| Day14 | Consolidate | Pick 3 best moves and add to your carry list. |

Follow the order; write one sentence daily on what you learned.

free_blocks.title: Methodology
free_blocks.content:
**Scoring (Production v1.0)**

1) 60 items use a 5‑point scale; reverse‑keyed items are flipped before aggregation (6 − response).
2) Each quadrant has 15 items. Raw sums are mapped to standard scores (mean 100, SD 15).
3) Response‑quality indicators are computed (time, long‑stringing, extreme/neutral bias, internal consistency). Only A/B quality enters the norm pool.
4) This free report includes cross‑quadrant insights and a 14‑day training plan to convert understanding into practice.

free_blocks.title: Closing Notes
free_blocks.content:
**How to use this report**: Treat this as guidance for self‑reflection and skill training. A retake interval of at least 14 days improves stability.
This platform does not use a single test result for labeling decisions.

scientific_contract.test_definition: 这份报告来自你对 60 道题的自我描述，整理的是本次作答中的情绪觉察、调节、共情理解与关系行动倾向；它不是外部观察或客观能力测验。
scientific_contract.self_report_statement: EQ-60 是自我报告工具。结果适合用于自我理解、记录与复盘，但不能直接证明你在真实情境中的表现。
scientific_contract.non_clinical_statement: 本报告不用于临床诊断、治疗评估、医疗建议、危机处置或心理风险判断。若情绪困扰持续影响睡眠、工作、人际安全或日常功能，应寻求合格专业人士或现实支持。
scientific_contract.non_hiring_statement: 本结果不得用于招聘、录用、淘汰、晋升、岗位分配、绩效评估、团队筛选或任何高风险组织决策，也不应用来评价他人是否适合某个岗位。
scientific_contract.non_ability_statement: EQ-60 不是情绪能力测验、MSCEIT、认证工具、临床工具或招聘工具，不能证明真实沟通能力、关系能力或工作能力。
scientific_contract.norm_status_statement: 标准分、百分位和等级应结合报告所列参照版本理解。采用 bootstrap 等模型参照时，百分位是按模型参数估计的相对位置，不是实际样本内排名；采用样本参照时，应结合对应参照组和版本解读。它不是能力、价值或职业竞争力排名。
scientific_contract.quality_rules_statement: 解释置信度会参考作答速度、连续相同选择、极端选择、中立选择和一致性线索。低置信结果应优先作为作答质量提示和复测建议，不适合输出强画像、强职业判断或强下一步练习重点。
scientific_contract.version_statement: 报告记录题目、计分、常模和内容版本，便于复测比较与质量追踪；版本号不代表临床、招聘或能力认证。
scientific_contract.user_safe_summary: 适合用于自我理解、关系复盘、低风险沟通练习和职业环境变量反思。
scientific_contract.do_not_overread: 请把报告看作本次自我报告的解释草图，不要用于临床诊断、招聘筛选、职业预测、工作表现预测或对他人的评价。

global_index.how_to_use: 先用总览定位，再回到四维、答题质量、证据状态和现实场景。不要用总分单独评价自己或他人。

score_notes.band: 等级用于降低阅读负担，不代表固定人格、能力证书、临床结论、招聘信号或职业判断。

foundational.label: 基础发展中
foundational.meaning: 当前信号提示本次结果提示可以先建立更清晰的识别、命名和复位习惯。
foundational.strength: 从一个小而重复的动作开始，进步会更稳定。
foundational.risk: 如果直接追求复杂沟通技巧，容易因为基础信号不清而挫败。
foundational.practice_focus: 每天一次情绪命名，配合一个低成本复位动作。
foundational.do_not_overread: 先把这一等级当作练习起点，不要当成能力下限。

developing.label: 发展中
developing.meaning: 你已有可用基础，但在反馈、压力或关系拉扯中稳定性还会下降。
developing.strength: 你已经能抓住一部分线索，适合把它们转成固定流程。
developing.risk: 最容易卡在“知道一点，但现场用不上”。
developing.practice_focus: 选择一个高频场景，提前准备一句回应。
developing.do_not_overread: 它描述本次自评的可用程度，不代表真实场景中总是如此。

stable.label: 稳定可用
stable.meaning: 多数日常场景中，你能使用这些情绪与关系模式，但仍有明确触发点。
stable.strength: 你的结果已经能支持更精细的场景训练。
stable.risk: 稳定不等于没有代价，尤其在高强度关系环境中。
stable.practice_focus: 找出最容易失稳的一个场景，做事后复盘。
stable.do_not_overread: “稳定”仍会受压力和情境影响，不是固定特质证明。

proficient.label: 熟练成熟
proficient.meaning: 你通常能较稳定地识别、调节和处理关系信号。
proficient.strength: 你可以把个人优势转成可复制的沟通习惯。
proficient.risk: 他人可能默认你应该一直承担稳定局面的角色。
proficient.practice_focus: 把“我能处理”升级为“我选择如何处理”。
proficient.do_not_overread: “熟练”不是客观能力认证，也不要求你一直承担稳定他人的责任。

integrated.label: 高度整合
integrated.meaning: 四维信号通常能协同工作，帮助你兼顾自己、他人和关系目标。
integrated.strength: 你适合把优势系统化，形成边界、修复和恢复节奏。
integrated.risk: 高整合也可能带来过度承担和高标准疲劳。
integrated.practice_focus: 建立恢复边界，避免把稳定别人变成默认责任。
integrated.do_not_overread: “整合”不等于没有盲点，也不能用于职业或人事判断。

SA.label: 自我觉察
SA.definition: 对自己情绪、触发点、身体信号和当下需要的自我报告识别倾向；它不是外部观察到的自我理解能力，也不保证现场表达一定清楚。
SA.what_high_can_look_like: 你能较快识别自己的感受和触发点，但仍需把觉察转化为行动。
SA.what_low_can_look_like: 情绪常在事后才变清楚，容易先反应后理解。
SA.development_question: 我此刻真正的感受和需要是什么？
SA.do_not_overread: 自我觉察分数描述本次自我报告中的相对倾向，不是能力证明、固定标签、诊断结论或外部行为预测。

ER.label: 情绪调节
ER.definition: 对自己在压力、反馈、挫败或冲突后暂停、复位和选择回应方式的自我报告倾向；它不等同于永远冷静、压住情绪或抗压能力证明。
ER.what_high_can_look_like: 你在压力中较能暂停、恢复和选择回应，但不代表没有情绪。
ER.what_low_can_look_like: 被触发后恢复较慢，容易用回避、解释或压抑处理。
ER.development_question: 我能不能先让自己降一点温，再决定怎么回应？
ER.do_not_overread: 情绪调节分数描述本次自我报告中的相对倾向，不是能力证明、固定标签、诊断结论或外部行为预测。

EM.label: 共情理解
EM.definition: 对他人情绪线索、观点和可能感受的自我报告理解倾向；它包含认知共情和情感共鸣线索，但不等同于读心准确率、亲社会行为或替他人承担情绪痛苦。
EM.what_high_can_look_like: 你能敏锐捕捉他人的状态，但需要避免过度吸收。
EM.what_low_can_look_like: 可能更关注任务或事实，较容易漏过对方的情绪线索。
EM.development_question: 对方真正担心或在意的是什么？
EM.do_not_overread: 共情理解分数描述本次自我报告中的相对倾向，不是能力证明、固定标签、诊断结论或外部行为预测。

RM.label: 关系管理
RM.definition: 对表达、协作、边界和关系修复的自我报告倾向；它不直接预测关系质量、领导力、受欢迎程度或他人评价。
RM.what_high_can_look_like: 你能维护沟通和关系质量，但仍需留意真实表达和边界。
RM.what_low_can_look_like: 知道自己或对方感受后，不一定能把对话修复或推进。
RM.development_question: 这句话怎样说，既真实又能让关系继续对话？
RM.do_not_overread: 关系管理分数描述本次自我报告中的相对倾向，不是能力证明、固定标签、诊断结论或外部行为预测。

core_formulation.title: 本次作答模式：基础线索仍在建立
core_formulation.one_liner: 本次自我报告显示，你对情绪觉察、调节、共情或关系处理的信心可能还不稳定。
core_formulation.core_claim: 这不是能力不足诊断，也不说明你在现实中一定表现差；它更可能说明当前自我感知里可用策略、语言和复盘经验还需要建立。
evidence_basis: 四维相对位置与本次作答质量共同支持这段解读，仍需用真实情境核对。
core_formulation.primary_strength: 本次作答提示一种可能：你已经有一个起点：能把这些维度放到同一张图里看，而不是只用“我情商高/低”概括。
core_formulation.likely_cost: 如果过早给自己贴标签，可能会忽略具体场景里的可练习部分。
core_formulation.development_lever: 先从一个低风险场景开始：命名情绪、确认需要、选择一个小回应。
core_formulation.do_not_overread: 这段解读需要用真实反馈和具体情境验证，不能替代对行为的观察。
core_formulation.share_line: 本次自我报告显示，基础策略还在建立，适合从小场景和可复盘动作开始。

mechanisms.title: 自我觉察 × 情绪调节：链条仍在建立
mechanisms.why_it_matters: 这条机制关注你如何把“知道自己怎么了”接到恢复和回应上。它能帮助用户定位链条中哪个环节更需要观察，但不能单独推出真实行为。
mechanisms.what_it_feels_like: 两端的自我报告信心都偏弱时，这条机制更适合作为练习入口，而不是结论。
mechanisms.strength: 优势是问题被拆小了，可以从一个低风险场景开始。
mechanisms.cost: 成本是如果直接贴标签，容易把可练习的环节误读成固定缺陷。
mechanisms.development_lever: 下一步练习重点：把情绪命名后，增加一个降速或恢复步骤。请把它作为下一次复盘的具体入口，而不是固定缺陷证明。
mechanisms.micro_action: 微行动：下一次相似场景里，只做一步。把情绪命名后，增加一个降速或恢复步骤。
mechanisms.do_not_overread: 请在真实场景中核对“识别自身状态并留出恢复步骤”；SA_ER 分数组合不能证明因果或能力。

mechanisms.title: 共情理解 × 关系管理：链条仍在建立
mechanisms.why_it_matters: 这条机制关注你如何把读到的情绪线索转成可见、合适的关系行动。它能帮助用户定位链条中哪个环节更需要观察，但不能单独推出真实行为。
mechanisms.what_it_feels_like: 两端的自我报告信心都偏弱时，这条机制更适合作为练习入口，而不是结论。
mechanisms.strength: 优势是问题被拆小了，可以从一个低风险场景开始。
mechanisms.cost: 成本是如果直接贴标签，容易把可练习的环节误读成固定缺陷。
mechanisms.development_lever: 下一步练习重点：把理解转成一个小动作：确认、提问、给选择，而不是替对方决定。请把它作为下一次复盘的具体入口，而不是固定缺陷证明。
mechanisms.micro_action: 微行动：下一次相似场景里，只做一步。把理解转成一个小动作：确认、提问、给选择，而不是替对方决定。
mechanisms.do_not_overread: 请在真实场景中核对“理解他人后选择合适的关系回应”；EM_RM 分数组合不能证明因果或能力。

reality_scenes.title: 反馈：把评价落到具体行为
reality_scenes.typical_response: 本次作答显示“基础线索仍在建立”这条自我感知线索。收到反馈时，建议验证：你能否把任务信息与对人格的评价分开，再选择回应。
reality_scenes.strength: 可用之处是把模糊评价还原成可讨论的事实；是否做得到，需要看真实反馈记录。
reality_scenes.cost: 若把语气当成全部信息，或把任务评价听成人格否定，回应可能偏离问题。
reality_scenes.better_move: 只做一件事：请对方指出一项具体行为及其影响。
reality_scenes.micro_script: 你能指出一个具体行为，以及它造成的影响吗？
reality_scenes.reflection_question: 对方说的是哪项行为？你当时把它理解成了什么评价？
reality_scenes.reflection_prompt: 记录具体行为、实际影响和你要追问的一点。
reality_scenes.do_not_overread: 若反馈含羞辱、威胁或明显权力压迫，先确保安全并寻求支持。
reality_scenes.why_this_matters: 把笼统评价变成一次可核对的行为讨论。
reality_scenes.tiny_experiment: 下一次收到反馈，只记录对方指出的行为和影响，再决定是否回应。
reality_scenes.result_page_depth: 用于反馈复盘，不用于推断对方评价或你的能力。
reality_scenes.context: 别人指出问题、要求修改，或评价你的成果与沟通时。

reality_scenes.title: 冲突：缩小问题，必要时暂停
reality_scenes.typical_response: 本次作答显示“基础线索仍在建立”这条自我感知线索。冲突升温时，建议验证：你是否能区分当前争议、旧账和安全风险，而不是一次处理全部问题。
reality_scenes.strength: 可用之处是看见冲突中真正需要处理的那一小块，而不是证明谁是对的人。
reality_scenes.cost: 问题越堆越多时，解释、防御或退让都可能取代实际解决。
reality_scenes.better_move: 只做一件事：把争议缩小到当前一个可处理的问题；不安全时停止对话。
reality_scenes.micro_script: 我们先只谈这一件事；如果现在不能安全地谈，我会先暂停。
reality_scenes.reflection_question: 当前必须处理的一个问题是什么？此刻是否具备安全、平等的对话条件？
reality_scenes.reflection_prompt: 记录当前争议、可暂停的界线和一个安全下一步。
reality_scenes.do_not_overread: 有威胁、控制、暴力或明显权力差时，暂停不是失败，安全优先。
reality_scenes.why_this_matters: 把冲突缩小到一个问题，同时保留暂停权。
reality_scenes.tiny_experiment: 下一次分歧出现时，先写下一句对当前问题的描述，不追加旧账。
reality_scenes.result_page_depth: 用于冲突复盘，不用于预测你会如何处理分歧。
reality_scenes.context: 意见分歧、语气升高、彼此防御，或问题迟迟无法推进时。

reality_scenes.title: 关系边界：承认感受，说明范围
reality_scenes.typical_response: 本次作答显示“基础线索仍在建立”这条自我感知线索。面对他人的情绪或请求时，建议验证：你能否既承认对方感受，也如实说明自己能做与不能做的范围。
reality_scenes.strength: 可用之处是把关心与无限责任分开，让善意有清楚的边界。
reality_scenes.cost: 只表达理解却不说明范围，容易让临时帮助变成长期义务。
reality_scenes.better_move: 只做一件事：用一句话同时说出理解，以及能做和不能做的范围。
reality_scenes.micro_script: 我听见这件事让你很难受；我能做的是……，不能做的是……。
reality_scenes.reflection_question: 你真心愿意承担哪一部分？哪一部分超出了时间、责任或安全边界？
reality_scenes.reflection_prompt: 记录你理解的感受、能做的事和不能做的事。
reality_scenes.do_not_overread: 边界不能替代安全计划；控制、威胁或暴力情境应优先寻求现实支持。
reality_scenes.why_this_matters: 把关心和承担分开，形成可表达的边界。
reality_scenes.tiny_experiment: 下一次答应请求前，先写下自己能承担的范围，再开口回应。
reality_scenes.result_page_depth: 用于边界复盘，不用于判断关系质量。
reality_scenes.context: 别人期待你理解、帮忙、让步，或继续承接情绪时。

career_environment.label: 反馈强度：较低
career_environment.meaning: 被评价、修改、复盘、公开比较或快速迭代的频率
career_environment.fit_signal: 观察反馈频率、具体程度和修正空间。
career_environment.strain_signal: 可能增加消耗的条件：如果规则、权力差、支持系统和恢复空间不清楚，反馈强度较低也可能带来额外压力。
career_environment.interview_question: 低反馈是否意味着自主空间，还是意味着标准不清？
role_observation_checklist: 反馈是否指向行为而非人格
是否有修改资源和时间
是否公开比较或羞辱
career_environment.team_risk: 反馈规则不清时，评价容易变成猜测或情绪负担。
career_environment.recovery_condition: 核对反馈是否具体到行为，并允许澄清和复盘。
career_environment.what_to_verify: 低反馈是否意味着自主空间，还是意味着标准不清？ 同时观察具体角色、组织文化、管理方式、权力结构、团队资源和你的当前生活阶段。
career_environment.do_not_overread: 反馈强度不能预测你的绩效或录用结果。

career_environment.label: 自主恢复空间：中等
career_environment.meaning: 工作是否允许暂停、独处、切换节奏和从情绪负荷中恢复
career_environment.fit_signal: 观察忙乱或情绪负荷上升时，暂停和交接是否真的可用。
career_environment.strain_signal: 可能增加消耗的条件：如果规则、权力差、支持系统和恢复空间不清楚，自主恢复空间中等也可能带来额外压力。
career_environment.interview_question: 恢复空间是否可预期，还是只取决于当天气氛？
role_observation_checklist: 是否能安排短暂停顿
是否有交接和替补机制
自主是否变成无人支持
career_environment.team_risk: 只有责任没有支援时，表面自主可能变成独自承压。
career_environment.recovery_condition: 核对恢复时间是否可预期，而不是取决于当天气氛。
career_environment.what_to_verify: 恢复空间是否可预期，还是只取决于当天气氛？ 同时观察具体角色、组织文化、管理方式、权力结构、团队资源和你的当前生活阶段。
career_environment.do_not_overread: 恢复空间是需要验证的条件，不是录用或绩效信号。

action_prescription.title: 情绪命名练习
action_prescription.why_this_matters: 把模糊的不舒服拆成一个具体情绪词，而不是马上解释或压下去。
action_prescription.do_today: 今天只做一个动作：在一个低风险场景里使用“我先不急着判断对错。我现在更像是感到……”这句话。
action_prescription.script: 我先不急着判断对错。我现在更像是感到……

seven_day_plan.practice: 写下今天最明显的一个情绪词。
把一个情绪拆成事实、感受、请求。
记录身体里最先出现的信号。
把“我很烦”改成更具体的词。
在一次对话后补写真实感受。
找出一个最常见触发点。
选一个下周继续使用的情绪词。

action_prescription.common_failure: 最常见失败不是不会做，而是等到情绪已经很满才想起来做。
action_prescription.repair_move: 如果没做到，不要重开整套计划；只复盘一个触发点和下一次第一句话。
action_prescription.watch_out: 不要把这个练习当成必须立刻改变自己或改变对方的任务。优先选择低风险、可退出、没有明显权力压迫的场景，只观察一次更清楚的停顿、表达或复盘。
action_prescription.do_not_overread: 请把「情绪命名练习」当作低风险自我观察和沟通准备，不是治疗、危机处理、关系修复保证，也不适用于不安全、胁迫、虐待、创伤触发或明显权力不对等的场景。若涉及安全、持续困扰或高冲突关系，应优先寻求可信支持或专业帮助。

sjt_bridge.title: 当前报告范围
sjt_bridge.description: 当前报告只包含 EQ-60 自我报告结果，不包含情境任务结果。
sjt_bridge.what_it_adds: 当前没有可供解读的情境任务数据。
sjt_bridge.what_it_is_not: 这不是 MSCEIT，也不提供客观能力证据。
sjt_bridge.do_not_overread: 本页不提供情境任务入口或结论。

boundary.title: 跨测评上下文边界
boundary.summary: 这一模块只说明相关测评可以怎样辅助阅读 EQ-60 结果。它不是把多个测试合成一个更“真实”的结论。
boundary.how_to_use: 把 MBTI、大五、九型、RIASEC 等结果当作不同问题框架下的反思线索：它们可以帮助提出问题，但不能改写 EQ 分数、替代 EQ-60 自我报告，或证明现实行为。
boundary.claim_boundary: 不用于情商能力排名、职业预测、招聘筛选、临床诊断、关系结局判断、固定人格标签或高风险决策。

quality_confidence.label: 高解释置信度
quality_confidence.body: 本次作答节奏和一致性支持正常阅读报告。
quality_confidence.user_guidance: 可以阅读核心模式、维度摘要和行动建议，但仍应把它们理解为本次自我报告的解释，不是能力排名或外部评价。
quality_confidence.retest_note: 如果你想观察变化，建议在 30–90 天后或经历明显生活变化后复测。
quality_confidence.why_this_level: 作答速度、连续相同选择、极端/中立选择和一致性线索未显示明显质量风险。
quality_confidence.how_to_read: 先看关键发现和分数依据，再结合现实场景判断哪些描述与近期经验相符。
quality_confidence.what_to_trust: 可以较稳定地参考维度间的相对强弱、主要解读和已选场景。
quality_confidence.what_to_hold_lightly: 具体分数、百分位和等级采用阶段性参照。模型参照不表示实际样本内排名；样本参照只适用于对应参照组和版本。不应将其用于精确能力排名、诊断或职业判断。

psychometric_evidence_status.body: 当前标准分、百分位和等级采用阶段性参照。bootstrap 等模型参照表示按模型参数估计的位置，不表示实际样本内排名；采用样本参照时，应结合对应参照组和版本理解。它们不是全球正式常模、能力排名或现实表现排名。
psychometric_evidence_status.do_not_overread: 先核对参照版本；bootstrap 等模型参照不表示实际样本内排名，样本参照也只适用于对应参照组和版本。
psychometric_evidence_status.what_this_means_for_user: 分数适合帮助你定位本次作答的大致相对位置，但不适合用于比较个人价值、能力高低、职业前景或关系质量。
psychometric_evidence_status.next_validation_step: 继续扩大样本、分层检查语言/地区/年龄等变量，定期发布常模版本说明和解释限制。

psychometric_evidence_status.body: EQ-60 的题项、四维结构和结果页解释已经按“自我报告的情绪与关系功能”做了内容映射。当前证据重点支持内容覆盖和解释边界，不等同于正式效标验证或能力测量。
psychometric_evidence_status.do_not_overread: 当前只支持内容覆盖与解释边界。
psychometric_evidence_status.what_this_means_for_user: 你可以把报告当作结构化自我反思工具，帮助整理情绪觉察、调节、共情和关系管理的自我感知线索。
psychometric_evidence_status.next_validation_step: 继续由心理测量、临床边界和本地化审阅人员复核题项覆盖、维度归属、文化语境和误读风险。

psychometric_evidence_status.body: 内部一致性需要在足够样本量下按语言、地区和维度分别估计，并随题库和报告版本记录。当前页面不应展示为已完成的信度结论。
psychometric_evidence_status.do_not_overread: 内部一致性证据仍需按语言和维度积累。
psychometric_evidence_status.what_this_means_for_user: 当前维度分可以帮助阅读本次作答模式，但不应被当作已经完成充分信度验证的稳定测量结果。
psychometric_evidence_status.next_validation_step: 积累样本后报告各维度的 alpha/omega 或更合适的信度指标，并检查低质量作答对信度估计的影响。

psychometric_evidence_status.body: 四维模型目前是报告解释框架，仍需用适合的探索性/验证性方法检验题项是否稳定支持 SA、ER、EM、RM 四个维度。
psychometric_evidence_status.do_not_overread: 四维结构仍需在更大样本中检验。
psychometric_evidence_status.what_this_means_for_user: 四维矩阵适合帮助你组织阅读，但不应被理解为已经完成充分跨样本验证的最终因子模型。
psychometric_evidence_status.next_validation_step: 在更大样本中进行 EFA/CFA、项目载荷、维度相关和模型拟合检查，并按语言版本分别复核。

psychometric_evidence_status.body: 重测稳定性尚需在合适时间窗内观察。EQ-60 涉及自我感知，短期生活压力、关系事件和作答状态都可能影响结果。
psychometric_evidence_status.do_not_overread: 趋势比较应在 30–90 天后或明显生活变化后进行。
psychometric_evidence_status.what_this_means_for_user: 如果你的近期状态变化很大，请把本次结果视为当前阶段的自我报告快照，而不是永久标签。
psychometric_evidence_status.next_validation_step: 在 30–90 天等合理窗口内比较复测结果，区分稳定自我感知、情境波动和低质量作答影响。

psychometric_evidence_status.body: 中英文版本、不同地区和不同用户群之间的等值性仍需检验。没有等值性证据时，不应直接比较不同语言或群体的分数含义。
psychometric_evidence_status.do_not_overread: 不同语言与群体的分数不应直接比较。
psychometric_evidence_status.user_facing_status_label: 跨语言/群体等值性：计划验证
psychometric_evidence_status.what_this_means_for_user: 中文和英文报告都可以用于本地化自我反思，但不要把不同语言、文化或群体之间的百分位差异读成能力差异。
psychometric_evidence_status.next_validation_step: 按语言和主要用户群检查 DIF、项目理解差异、维度结构和分数分布，必要时调整解释而不是强行统一。

psychometric_evidence_status.body: 外部关联证据尚未用于支持高风险判断。未来只能探索与低风险指标的关联，例如自我报告的压力恢复、沟通满意度或成长目标完成度。
psychometric_evidence_status.do_not_overread: 当前结果不能预测关系、工作或健康结局。
psychometric_evidence_status.user_facing_status_label: 外部关联证据：计划探索
psychometric_evidence_status.what_this_means_for_user: 当前结果不能证明工作表现、关系结局、心理健康状态或职业成功，只能作为自我理解和低风险行动规划的参考。
psychometric_evidence_status.next_validation_step: 设计低风险、非招聘、非临床的外部指标研究，并明确相关不等于预测或因果。

result_page_depth_modules.title: 30 秒读法
result_page_depth_modules.body: 先记住一句“本次作答显示的核心模式”，再看一个证据点，最后只选一个低风险行动。不要把整份报告当成性格判决、能力排名或关系诊断。

result_page_depth_modules.title: 如何理解这份证据
result_page_depth_modules.body: 这份报告把四维自我报告分数、维度差距、答题质量和所选内容放在一起阅读。它提高的是解释结构，不是把你简化成一个能力分。
bullets: 四维信号：SA / ER / EM / RM 的自我报告位置
差距信号：最强维度与当前下一步练习重点
质量信号：本次作答能支持多强的解释
观察重点：哪些场景和行动最值得先观察
result_page_depth_modules.what_this_does_not_mean: “如何理解这份证据”仅用于组织本次自我报告，不能当作能力、诊断、招聘或职业预测。

result_page_depth_modules.title: 现实验证法
result_page_depth_modules.body: 未来一周只观察三件低风险线索：你最先注意到谁的情绪、你是否能说清一个边界、你事后大概需要多久恢复。遇到高冲突、创伤、不安全关系或明显权力差时，不要用这份报告替代专业支持。

result_page_depth_modules.title: 证据如何支持这个读法
result_page_depth_modules.body: “基础发展中”只是对本次自我报告的一种可能读法。请先用近期发生的具体例子核对它是否贴合。
bullets: 分数线索：多个维度处在较低或不稳定区间。
本次作答更适合提示哪些情绪与关系线索值得先观察。
这些线索需要结合现实反馈、关系安全度、文化语境和当时压力一起理解。
result_page_depth_modules.what_this_does_not_mean: “证据如何支持这个读法”仅用于组织本次自我报告，不能当作能力、诊断、招聘或职业预测。
result_page_depth_modules.next_read: 接着看现实场景、职业环境变量和一个低风险行动；把它当作观察假设，而不是定论。

agent_dialogue_playbooks.title: 理解我的结果
agent_dialogue_playbooks.response_policy: 先引用后端报告已选择的 解读、分数线索和质量状态，再邀请用户选择一个现实场景。不得重新打分、改 解读 或给出能力/高风险判断。
agent_dialogue_playbooks.clarifying_question: 你想先看哪个场景：反馈、冲突、边界、协作、压力恢复，还是职业环境变量？
agent_dialogue_playbooks.safe_response_example: 我会按你报告里的已解析资产解释，不会重新判定你是什么人，也不会替代现实反馈。
agent_dialogue_playbooks.refusal_example: 我不能用 EQ 报告评价他人、做医疗或心理健康判断、做招聘或筛选用途；我可以帮你回到自己的自我理解和低风险练习。
agent_dialogue_playbooks.escalation_rule: 涉及伤害风险、持续困扰、招聘/筛选用途、第三方评价或要求改分时，先给边界说明，并建议使用现实支持或人工审核。

agent_dialogue_playbooks.title: 把结果放进一个场景
agent_dialogue_playbooks.response_policy: 只围绕一个用户选择的场景调用 reality scene、mechanism 和 action 资产。避免泛化到所有关系或所有工作场景。
agent_dialogue_playbooks.clarifying_question: 这个场景发生在哪里、对象是谁、你希望结果更像理解自己还是准备一句回应？
agent_dialogue_playbooks.safe_response_example: 我可以把报告里的场景解释转成一个低风险观察点和一句可选表达。
agent_dialogue_playbooks.refusal_example: 如果场景涉及不安全关系、威胁、持续伤害或法律/医疗问题，我不能用报告给处理方案；应优先寻求现实支持。
agent_dialogue_playbooks.escalation_rule: 出现安全、创伤、高冲突或明显权力差时，不做脚本推进，先提示边界和现实支持。

agent_dialogue_playbooks.title: 验证工作环境变量
agent_dialogue_playbooks.response_policy: 只讨论人际密度、反馈强度、情绪劳动、冲突频率、自主恢复空间和协作复杂度等环境变量。不得推荐具体职业、岗位、招聘结论或工作表现预测。
agent_dialogue_playbooks.clarifying_question: 你更想验证哪一类变量：反馈强度、冲突频率、情绪劳动，还是恢复空间？
agent_dialogue_playbooks.safe_response_example: 我可以把报告里的职业环境资产转成面试验证问题或岗位观察清单，但不会说你适合或不适合某个职业。
agent_dialogue_playbooks.refusal_example: 我不能用 EQ 结果判断录用、筛选候选人、预测绩效或替你决定职业路径。
agent_dialogue_playbooks.escalation_rule: 当用户要求职业推荐、录用判断、绩效预测或评价他人时，拒绝高风险用途并回到环境变量验证。

agent_dialogue_playbooks.title: 低置信结果怎么读
agent_dialogue_playbooks.response_policy: 低置信时先解释质量限制、复测条件和可保留的轻量观察。不得输出确定性画像、职业判断或行动承诺。
agent_dialogue_playbooks.clarifying_question: 你想知道为什么置信度低，还是想准备一次更稳定的复测？
agent_dialogue_playbooks.safe_response_example: 这次更适合当作复测前的提醒：看环境、速度、注意力和是否有中断。
agent_dialogue_playbooks.refusal_example: 我不会基于低置信结果给你强画像、职业判断、关系判断或确定练习承诺。
agent_dialogue_playbooks.escalation_rule: 质量为 C/D、SPEEDING 或一致性不足时，始终优先复测边界和轻量观察。

agent_dialogue_playbooks.title: 不支持的高风险用途
agent_dialogue_playbooks.response_policy: 用户要求用 EQ 结果评价他人、招聘、筛选、诊疗、认证或预测绩效时，必须拒绝，并说明报告只支持自我理解和低风险反思。
agent_dialogue_playbooks.clarifying_question: 如果你的目标是自我理解，我可以改为帮你看一个具体场景或环境变量。你想看哪一个？
agent_dialogue_playbooks.safe_response_example: 可以讨论你自己的沟通、恢复、边界和环境验证问题。
agent_dialogue_playbooks.refusal_example: 我不能把 EQ 报告用于招聘或筛选、医疗或心理健康判断、认证能力、评价他人或推断绩效或工作结果。
agent_dialogue_playbooks.escalation_rule: 这类请求只给拒绝边界和安全替代路径，不继续追问敏感对象或提供评判结论。

agent_runtime_copy.default_response: 我会基于当前报告资产解释你的 EQ 结果，不会重新打分或替换报告判断。

backend_integration_contract.title: Schema 映射
backend_integration_contract.requirement: 每个 EQ 资产文件必须映射到 content-pack compiler 可识别的结构，并保留稳定 内容 ID、locale 字段、风险边界和触发逻辑。
backend_integration_contract.acceptance: content:lint、content:compile、mirror drift check、canonical fixtures 和 report contract tests 通过后，资产才能进入报告 payload。
backend_integration_contract.do_not_overread: Schema 通过只说明资产结构可读，不代表内容可用于医疗、人事、能力认证或绩效判断。

backend_integration_contract.title: 前端消费契约
backend_integration_contract.requirement: 前端只能渲染后端 resolved 内容 与 UI chrome。正式报告解释、科学边界、行动建议和职业环境变量不得在前端硬编码。
backend_integration_contract.acceptance: 缺少资产、locale mismatch、guardrail 异常或 access 异常时，前端应 fail closed，不显示访问门槛入口、不显示技术 tag、不改写 解读。
backend_integration_contract.do_not_overread: 前端可以负责交互与布局，但不是报告内容、分数、职业判断或 Agent 回答的权威来源。

backend_integration_contract.title: Canonical fixtures
backend_integration_contract.requirement: 至少维护 balanced、high_empathy_low_recovery、low_confidence 与代表性 阅读顺序 路径的 zh-CN / en payload 样本。
backend_integration_contract.acceptance: fixtures 覆盖 all-free、低置信、阅读顺序 selection、resolved 内容、SJT planned/unavailable、无权限门槛和无 raw tag 泄漏。
backend_integration_contract.do_not_overread: fixture 是合同样本，不是常模样本，也不是用户分布或科学验证证据。

backend_integration_contract.title: 契约测试
backend_integration_contract.requirement: contract tests 必须断言 EQ report payload 包含当前版本资产、分数/维度摘要、质量解释、解释选择、科学边界、免费访问状态与 SJT unavailable 状态。
backend_integration_contract.acceptance: 测试失败时不得通过前端 fallback、Agent fallback 或静态文案绕过后端资产合同。
backend_integration_contract.do_not_overread: 契约测试保护交付形状和边界，不证明测验具备临床、招聘或能力评估效度。

backend_integration_contract.title: Agent 只读契约
backend_integration_contract.requirement: Agent 只能基于 report_context、resolved_内容、retrieval tags、intent map 与 forbidden-claim metadata 做解释。它不能改分数、改 解读、改 section、开启 SJT、生成权限门槛，或替代后端报告权威。
backend_integration_contract.acceptance: Agent context 与 runtime response 都返回 read_only=true，并明确 can_mutate_report=false、can_mutate_scores=false、can_override_解读=false、can_enable_sjt=false、can_expose_raw_technical_tags=false。
backend_integration_contract.do_not_overread: Agent 是反思与解释辅助，不是治疗师、招聘评估者、能力测验评分员或第三方评价工具。

blocks.title: 重要声明
blocks.content:
本测评为自评问卷，用于自我探索与能力训练方向参考，不构成医疗诊断或心理治疗建议。
结果受作答状态、理解方式与作答质量影响。
当你出现持续的情绪困扰、睡眠显著受影响、工作/学习/关系功能受损时，建议寻求专业心理支持。

blocks.title: 作答质量提示
blocks.content: 本次答卷质量等级为 **A**：一致性与作答节奏表现稳定，结果解释可靠度较高。

blocks.title: 综合概览
blocks.content:
你的综合 EQ 标准分为 **105**（人群平均 100，标准差 15），处于第 **60** 百分位。

本测评基于四项能力：自我情绪认知（SA）、情绪调节（ER）、同理心与社会感知（EM）、社交管理（RM）。报告会给出各维度的标准分与发展阶段，用于定位优势与训练重点。

本次作答质量等级：**A**。

blocks.title: 自我情绪认知 · 稳定可用（Competent）
blocks.content:
**本维度：自我情绪认知（Self‑Awareness）**

标准分：****（第  百分位），阶段：**稳定可用（Competent）**。

你通常能识别情绪，并把情绪与触发点、需求联系起来。你能在大部分场景下清楚表达“我正在紧张/我需要时间/我被忽视了”。这种能力能明显降低误解与内耗，让沟通更聚焦问题本身，而不是被情绪噪音牵着走。

**练习提示**：在关键对话前，用一句话写清“我在乎什么”，让表达更稳定。

blocks.title: 情绪调节与控制 · 稳定可用（Competent）
blocks.content:
**本维度：情绪调节与控制（Emotion Regulation）**

标准分：****（第  百分位），阶段：**稳定可用（Competent）**。

你一般能把情绪强度控制在可管理范围内，能暂停、复盘、再行动。偶尔会被情绪带走，但你知道怎样回到轨道：调整呼吸、改变环境、转向更具体的行动。你在高压任务中更容易保持持续输出。

**练习提示**：把“反刍”改为“下一步”：写下 1 个能在 10 分钟内完成的动作。

blocks.title: 同理心与社会感知 · 稳定可用（Competent）
blocks.content:
**本维度：同理心与社会感知（Social Awareness & Empathy）**

标准分：****（第  百分位），阶段：**稳定可用（Competent）**。

你能比较稳定地识别他人情绪，并理解情绪背后的需要。你在多数社交场景中能做到“听懂言外之意”，也更容易在冲突里保持尊重与连接。你的共情能力能显著提升合作质量与亲密关系安全感。

**练习提示**：在给建议前先问一句“你希望我倾听还是一起想办法？”

blocks.title: 社交技能与人际管理 · 稳定可用（Competent）
blocks.content:
**本维度：社交技能与人际管理（Relationship Management）**

标准分：****（第  百分位），阶段：**稳定可用（Competent）**。

你具备良好的沟通与协作能力，能建立稳定的人际网络与信任。你能在多数场景里表达观点、处理分歧、维持关系质量。你通常能在“真实表达”和“关系维护”之间找到平衡。

**练习提示**：遇到分歧时先对齐共同目标，再讨论方案。

blocks.title: 综合型
blocks.content:
**你的画像：综合型（未命中典型交叉画像）**

你的四个维度没有呈现出明显的“高低落差组合”，更像是均衡发展的曲线。这份免费报告会把每个维度的优势与盲点拆到具体场景，并给出 14 天游程，用于把分数转化为可执行的行为习惯。

你会看到：
- 你的四维雷达解读与短板定位
- 适配你分数结构的训练重点
- 可直接照做的对话脚本与练习清单

blocks.title: 通用成长计划
blocks.content:
**14 天游程：通用成长计划（每天 10–15 分钟）**

目标：用最小成本提升 EQ 四象限的基础能力。

| 天数 | 主题 | 今日练习 |
|---|---|---|
| Day 1 | 情绪命名 | 写下 3 个情绪词 + 触发点。 |
| Day 2 | 降温练习 | 缓慢呼气 6 次 + 身体扫描 1 分钟。 |
| Day 3 | 复述倾听 | 对话中复述 1 次对方感受，再进入讨论。 |
| Day 4 | 事实与请求 | 用三句式写下：事实/感受/请求。 |
| Day 5 | 小行动 | 完成 1 个 10 分钟行动，记录情绪变化。 |
| Day 6 | 边界句式 | 写 3 条“我能/我不能”的边界句。 |
| Day 7 | 关系连接 | 主动联系 1 人：表达感谢 + 具体反馈。 |
| Day 8 | 冲突降温 | 冲突时先共情 1 句，再对齐目标。 |
| Day 9 | 睡前卸载 | 写 5 行未完成清单 + 明天第一步。 |
| Day10 | 视角转换 | 写下对方最在乎的价值与担心。 |
| Day11 | 反馈练习 | 给出一次具体反馈：行为 + 影响 + 期待。 |
| Day12 | 精力恢复 | 安排 20 分钟恢复性活动。 |
| Day13 | 难对话脚本 | 写 5 句脚本：开场/共情/边界/方案/收尾。 |
| Day14 | 复盘巩固 | 选出最有效的 3 个动作，写入随身清单。 |

**使用方式**：按顺序完成即可，过程中用一句话记录今天的收获。

blocks.title: 方法说明
blocks.content:
**计分方法（上线版 v1.0）**

1) 60 题采用 5 点量表作答；反向题在计分前做翻转（6−选项值）。
2) 每个维度 15 题，先得到原始分，再转为标准分：平均 100、标准差 15。

free_blocks.title: 自我情绪认知 · 稳定可用（Competent）
free_blocks.content:
**本维度：自我情绪认知（Self‑Awareness）**

标准分：****（第  百分位），阶段：**稳定可用（Competent）**。

你通常能识别情绪，并把情绪与触发点、需求联系起来。你能在大部分场景下清楚表达“我正在紧张/我需要时间/我被忽视了”。这种能力能明显降低误解与内耗，让沟通更聚焦问题本身，而不是被情绪噪音牵着走。

**练习提示**：在关键对话前，用一句话写清“我在乎什么”，让表达更稳定。

free_blocks.title: 情绪调节与控制 · 稳定可用（Competent）
free_blocks.content:
**本维度：情绪调节与控制（Emotion Regulation）**

标准分：****（第  百分位），阶段：**稳定可用（Competent）**。

你一般能把情绪强度控制在可管理范围内，能暂停、复盘、再行动。偶尔会被情绪带走，但你知道怎样回到轨道：调整呼吸、改变环境、转向更具体的行动。你在高压任务中更容易保持持续输出。

**练习提示**：把“反刍”改为“下一步”：写下 1 个能在 10 分钟内完成的动作。

free_blocks.title: 同理心与社会感知 · 稳定可用（Competent）
free_blocks.content:
**本维度：同理心与社会感知（Social Awareness & Empathy）**

标准分：****（第  百分位），阶段：**稳定可用（Competent）**。

你能比较稳定地识别他人情绪，并理解情绪背后的需要。你在多数社交场景中能做到“听懂言外之意”，也更容易在冲突里保持尊重与连接。你的共情能力能显著提升合作质量与亲密关系安全感。

**练习提示**：在给建议前先问一句“你希望我倾听还是一起想办法？”

free_blocks.title: 社交技能与人际管理 · 稳定可用（Competent）
free_blocks.content:
**本维度：社交技能与人际管理（Relationship Management）**

标准分：****（第  百分位），阶段：**稳定可用（Competent）**。

你具备良好的沟通与协作能力，能建立稳定的人际网络与信任。你能在多数场景里表达观点、处理分歧、维持关系质量。你通常能在“真实表达”和“关系维护”之间找到平衡。

**练习提示**：遇到分歧时先对齐共同目标，再讨论方案。

free_blocks.title: 综合型
free_blocks.content:
**你的画像：综合型（未命中典型交叉画像）**

你的四个维度没有呈现出明显的“高低落差组合”，更像是均衡发展的曲线。这份免费报告会把每个维度的优势与盲点拆到具体场景，并给出 14 天游程，用于把分数转化为可执行的行为习惯。

- 适配你分数结构的训练重点
- 可直接照做的对话脚本与练习清单

free_blocks.title: 通用成长计划
free_blocks.content:
**14 天游程：通用成长计划（每天 10–15 分钟）**

目标：用最小成本提升 EQ 四象限的基础能力。

| 天数 | 主题 | 今日练习 |
|---|---|---|
| Day 1 | 情绪命名 | 写下 3 个情绪词 + 触发点。 |
| Day 2 | 降温练习 | 缓慢呼气 6 次 + 身体扫描 1 分钟。 |
| Day 3 | 复述倾听 | 对话中复述 1 次对方感受，再进入讨论。 |
| Day 4 | 事实与请求 | 用三句式写下：事实/感受/请求。 |
| Day 5 | 小行动 | 完成 1 个 10 分钟行动，记录情绪变化。 |
| Day 6 | 边界句式 | 写 3 条“我能/我不能”的边界句。 |
| Day 7 | 关系连接 | 主动联系 1 人：表达感谢 + 具体反馈。 |
| Day 8 | 冲突降温 | 冲突时先共情 1 句，再对齐目标。 |
| Day 9 | 睡前卸载 | 写 5 行未完成清单 + 明天第一步。 |
| Day10 | 视角转换 | 写下对方最在乎的价值与担心。 |
| Day11 | 反馈练习 | 给出一次具体反馈：行为 + 影响 + 期待。 |
| Day12 | 精力恢复 | 安排 20 分钟恢复性活动。 |
| Day13 | 难对话脚本 | 写 5 句脚本：开场/共情/边界/方案/收尾。 |
| Day14 | 复盘巩固 | 选出最有效的 3 个动作，写入随身清单。 |

**使用方式**：按顺序完成即可，过程中用一句话记录今天的收获。
